metadata.title: Minimalist High-Key Portrait with Geometric Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait of a single subject against a pure white background, featuring a large-scale geometric monolinear title that overlaps the subject's torso.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is requested
hand-drawn or serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-length or three-quarter studio portrait of a person in white clothing, isolated against a seamless white background. The lighting is soft and even, creating a high-key effect where the clothing almost blends into the backdrop. A large, thin-stroke geometric title is placed in the center, partially obscuring the subject to create depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Geometric circular forms of text contrasting with organic human silhouette
Warm brown tones of skin and text against a sterile white environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the vertical middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large geometric 'O' shapes in the title serve as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down to the large central typography, and then to the smaller subtitle on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on all sides, emphasizing the subject and the graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White (background and clothing) providing a clean, airy base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm brown (skin tones and typography) providing the only structural definition.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall with high contrast between the white field and the dark brown text.

letterConstructionRules: Extended vertical stems that cross through the baseline
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' features a vertical stem that extends significantly below the baseline.
The 'C' is a nearly closed circle.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same font family but at a much smaller scale for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a woman with dark skin and long straight hair, wearing a sleek white dress, centered against a pure white background. Soft lighting, minimal shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, thin-stroke geometric sans-serif title in dark brown across the center of the image, overlapping the subject's waist area. Add a smaller subtitle in the same font style below and to the right of the main title.

verificationChecks: Does the text overlap the subject?
Is the lighting high-key with minimal shadow detail?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the overlap.
Check that the white clothing doesn't completely disappear into the background.
Verify the typography is perfectly centered horizontally.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Pure white background + Large geometric monolinear overlay = Minimalist R&B Aesthetic
